scope: Nominal native CAD geometry and source-configured motion/service; manufacturer-drawing switch reconstruction, not factory switch CAD or physical actuation/load qualification

native_provenance.association: Operator-supplied native export/source association; original filenames and each member SHA256 are checked in report.
native_provenance.version_binding_note: Root verified the final b150 source in the native study, regenerated105 parts, exported all four native inputs, restored neutral stroke0/preload0/light/isometricOFF/electronicsON/handOFF, and created/opened this immutable R4 checkpoint. No geometry or validation tolerance changed during provenance binding.

only_changed_parts: P04 cam recess/pilots and old nub

switch_fit_reference.geometry_status: MANUFACTURER_DRAWING_BASED; NO_FACTORY_STEP; terminal/lug conservative envelopes; lever fixed-length motion approximate
switch_fit_reference.cam: M3x8 nominal; diameter5.5 x3 head and nominal L4 insert intent, actual stock unqualified
switch_fit_reference.limits: CAD proves nominal clearance only. OP tolerance, total travel, manual cam reset/locking, inserts, solder/wire bend/insulation/strain relief, and physical actuation remain unqualified.

preserved_geometry: P05 force web/integral sensing stops, P02/P03 palm7mm fit and all other99 native bodies retain exact geometry from frozen R3.
unchanged_operating_domain: 0<=preload<=2, stroke>=0, stroke+preload<=30 mm. Printed moving stop faces reduce maximum stroke to 30-preload. H10 cam must be manually reset by -preload after each preload change.
manual_setup_required: Reset H10 by-preload after every preload change, then calibrate/verify the actual switch operating and total travel and relock. The source pose creates no automatic mechanical coupling.

baseline_scope_comparison.name: R4 switch-fit change scope; exact unchanged native geometry identity

sensor_identity.requirement: Unmodified manufacturer BRep under a rigid unit-scale transform

exact_brep_pairs.reason: Verify coincident nominal TPU/core fit has no BRep material overlap

limitations: Native exports and source association are operator-declared and hash-bound; this script does not regenerate Onshape.
STL intersection tolerance is numerical, not a permitted design penetration or print clearance.

Actuator continuous certificates depend on manual H10 reset after each preload change and the stated FeatureScript kinematics. Native pose/source congruence is separately checked; the actual purchased switch and click force remain unqualified.
Selected wall-ray/probe checks do not establish a global minimum wall or strength.
No hand-volume clearance is inferred from an open scan in a provisional registration. No comfort qualification.
No spring fatigue/coil-bind or load-cell electrical/calibration qualification is established.
H09 terminals and lug are conservative dimensioned boxes, not exact manufacturer shapes. H09a/H09b use an approximate fixed-length rotating mechanism.
Actual solder joints, wire bends, insulation and strain relief are not modeled.
SS-01GL2 operating-position tolerance and total travel require physical cam calibration at every preload reset; nominal one-mm trip lead is not a guaranteed margin.
Actual inserts, screw/head/washer sizes, driver socket/handle fit, retention and printed500N working load remain unqualified.
500N remains a design target, not a verified printed working-load rating.
